title: Day 772: Two Men Shot Dead Inside Car Wash in Los Ángeles Sector, Culiacán
detail: Gunmen opened fire on two men inside the 'El Rey' car wash at the intersection of the road to Imala and Calle Pomona, in the Los Ángeles sector of northeastern Culiacán, at approximately 3:55 PM on Thursday, September 3, 2026. One victim was found at the entrance of the business office and the other in the rear washing area; both died at the scene. The men were unofficially identified by relatives as Clemente René 'N', 49, a Culiacán resident, and Celio 'N', 48, originally from Guasave. It remained undetermined whether the victims worked at the car wash or were customers. National Guard and federal security agents responded, and state forensic personnel processed the scene.

title: Day 772: Man Executed With High-Caliber Weapons on La Costerita Bypass, South Culiacán
detail: A man identified as Óscar 'N', 42, was killed in the early morning hours of Thursday, September 3, 2026, along the Benito Juárez bypass ('La Costerita') south of Culiacán, near a cement company. According to investigators, armed men transported the victim by vehicle, removed him, shot him with high-caliber weapons, and fled. Numerous spent shell casings were recovered at the scene. State prosecutors and forensic specialists processed the site and transferred the body to the medical examiner's office; no arrests were announced.
